docs.title: 10.12.3. src/components/ConfirmDialog.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  components/ConfirmDialog.vue - the "Are you sure?" dialog
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The one of example 12, completed for the keyboard like public/js/app.js
  of the HTML application:
    - on opening, the focus goes to "No, go back": an absent-minded press on
      Enter deletes nothing;
    - Escape closes the dialog (= No);
    - Tab and Shift+Tab stay INSIDE the dialog (otherwise the focus would go to
      the greyed-out page, behind);
    - on closing, the focus goes back to the element that had it (the
      "Delete" button clicked, for example).
  "No, go back" rather than "Cancel": the question is sometimes "Cancel this
  appointment?", and a "Cancel" button would be ambiguous there.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { nextTick, useTemplateRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { useConfirmation } from '../composables/useConfirmation';

const { t } = useI18n();
const { messageKey, respond } = useConfirmation();
const dialog = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('dialog');
const noButton = useTemplateRef<HTMLButtonElement>('noButton');
let previousFocus: HTMLElement | null = null;

watch(messageKey, async (key, oldKey) => {
  if (key !== null && oldKey === null) {
    previousFocus = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
    await nextTick(); // the dialog is now in the page
    noButton.value?.focus();
  } else if (key === null) {
    previousFocus?.focus();
    previousFocus = null;
  }
});

function onKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    respond(false);
  } else if (e.key === 'Tab' && dialog.value) {
    const buttons = [...dialog.value.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button')];
    const first = buttons[0];
    const last = buttons[buttons.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
      e.preventDefault();
      last?.focus();
    } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
      e.preventDefault();
      first?.focus();
    }
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Teleport to="body">
    <div v-if="messageKey !== null" @keydown="onKeydown">
      <div class="modal-backdrop fade show"></div>
      <div
        ref="dialog"
        class="modal fade show d-block"
        tabindex="-1"
        role="alertdialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="confirmation-title"
        aria-describedby="confirmation-message"
        @click.self="respond(false)"
      >
        <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
          <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">
              <h5 id="confirmation-title" class="modal-title">{{ t('CONFIRMATION.TITLE') }}</h5>
              <button type="button" class="btn-close" :aria-label="t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CLOSE_ARIA')" @click="respond(false)"></button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
              <p id="confirmation-message" class="mb-0">{{ t(messageKey) }}</p>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-footer">
              <button ref="noButton" type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" @click="respond(false)">{{ t('CONFIRMATION.NO') }}</button>
              <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger" @click="respond(true)">{{ t('CONFIRMATION.YES') }}</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </Teleport>
</template>

The window from Example 12, enhanced for keyboard navigation using the [public/js/app.js] script from the HTML application:

  • lines 29–38: Upon opening, the element that had focus (the “Delete” button that was clicked, for example) is retained, then focus is given to the “No, go back” button; upon closing, focus is returned to the retained element. A user navigating with the keyboard thus regains their position on the page;
  • lines 40–55: Esc is treated as “No”; Tab and Shift+Tab remain within the window: when reaching the last button, Tab returns to the first one (otherwise, focus would move to the grayed-out page behind it);
  • line 60: Keyboard input is handled by the window itself: no need to attach or detach a listener to the document;
  • line 68: for screen readers, the window’s title and message;
  • line 79: the message, translated.

docs.title: 10.12.4. src/components/InputField.vue
docs.text:
A complete form field, reused by all forms in the application:

<!--
  =========================================================================
  components/InputField.vue - a complete form field
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Label + field + help message OR error message, with v-model (see
  example 08). All the forms of the application use it:

    <InputField v-model="form.lastName" id="lastName" label="PERSONS.LASTNAME_LABEL"
                :error="errors.lastName" :params="params" :maxlength="20" />

  label, help and error are translation KEYS. An error outlines the
  field in red (Bootstrap class is-invalid) and replaces the help.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';

const model = defineModel<string>({ required: true });

withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    id: string;
    label: string;
    type?: 'text' | 'password';
    error?: string; // key of the error message of this field
    params?: Record<string, string>; // parameters of the messages ({min}...)
    help?: string; // key of the help message
    maxlength?: number;
    autocomplete?: string;
    required?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { type: 'text', error: undefined, params: () => ({}), help: undefined, maxlength: undefined, autocomplete: 'off', required: false },
);

const { t } = useI18n();
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <label class="form-label" :for="id">{{ t(label) }}</label>
    <input
      :id="id"
      v-model="model"
      :type="type"
      class="form-control"
      :class="{ 'is-invalid': error }"
      :maxlength="maxlength"
      :autocomplete="autocomplete"
      :required="required"
      :aria-invalid="error ? 'true' : undefined"
      :aria-describedby="`${id}-message`"
    >
    <div v-if="error" :id="`${id}-message`" class="invalid-feedback">{{ t(error, params) }}</div>
    <div v-else-if="help" :id="`${id}-message`" class="form-text">{{ t(help, params) }}</div>
  </div>
</template>
  • line 18: the field is used with [v-model] (see example 08);
  • lines 20–33: the props: the field ID, and the translation KEYS for the label, tooltip, and error message;
  • line 46: an error highlights the field in red;
  • line 51: the help or error message is associated with the field for screen readers;
  • lines 53–54: the error message REPLACES the help text.

When placed within a parent, the component also inherits the attributes passed down from the parent, even if they are not props: [<InputField class="col-sm-6" ...>] adds the class [col-sm-6] to its root element, [<div>] (these are known as “inherited” attributes, [fallthrough attributes]).

docs.title: 10.12.5. src/components/PersonFields.vue
docs.text:
The title, first name, and last name are common to three forms:

<!--
  =========================================================================
  components/PersonFields.vue - title, first name, last name
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The identity fields, common to three forms: the ADMIN's doctor / client
  form, "Create a patient account" and "Manage my account" (the equivalent of the
  partial views/partials/personFields.hbs). Three named v-models:
      <PersonFields v-model:title="f.title" v-model:firstName="f.firstName"
                    v-model:lastName="f.lastName" :errors="errors" />
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import InputField from './InputField.vue';

const title = defineModel<string>('title', { required: true });
const firstName = defineModel<string>('firstName', { required: true });
const lastName = defineModel<string>('lastName', { required: true });
defineProps<{ errors: Record<string, string> }>();

const { t } = useI18n();
const TITLES = ['Mr', 'Mme', 'Melle'];
</script>

<template>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label class="form-label" for="title">{{ t('PERSONS.TITLE_LABEL') }}</label>
    <select id="title" v-model="title" class="form-select" :class="{ 'is-invalid': errors.title }">
      <option v-for="tt in TITLES" :key="tt" :value="tt">{{ tt }}</option>
    </select>
    <div v-if="errors.title" class="invalid-feedback">{{ t(errors.title) }}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="row g-3 mb-3">
    <InputField v-model="firstName" class="col-sm-6" id="firstName" label="PERSONS.FIRSTNAME_LABEL" :error="errors.firstName" :maxlength="20" required />
    <InputField v-model="lastName" class="col-sm-6" id="lastName" label="PERSONS.LASTNAME_LABEL" :error="errors.lastName" :maxlength="20" required />
  </div>
</template>
  • Lines 16–18: three [v-model] fields named: the parent writes [v-model:title="..."], [v-model:firstName="..."], [v-model:lastName="..."];
  • line 34: both text fields are [InputField]. [firstName] is the [ref] of [defineModel]: the parent-child chain -> PersonFields -> InputField -> [<input>] works both ways.

A component can have multiple root elements (here, the [<div>] for the title and the row containing the two fields): this is referred to as a “fragment.”

docs.title: 10.12.6. src/components/CaptchaField.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  components/CaptchaField.vue - the captcha image and the input field
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Loads a captcha (GET /api/captcha) when displayed. The parent gets
  the input through v-model, and the identifier of the captcha through the exposed
  method captchaId(); it calls reload() after each attempt, because an
  image is used only ONCE (the server forgets it as soon as it has checked it).

  defineExpose: what a PARENT component can call on this component,
  thanks to a template ref (see LoginView.vue).

  v-html: the SVG image is inserted as is. Harmless HERE because
  it is built by our server (svg-captcha library) and does not
  contain anything that comes from a user - see example 17.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { rdvApi } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { Captcha } from '../api/types';

const input = defineModel<string>({ required: true });
defineProps<{ error?: string }>();

const { t } = useI18n();
const captcha = ref<Captcha | null>(null);

async function reload(): Promise<void> {
  input.value = '';
  try {
    captcha.value = await rdvApi.captcha();
  } catch {
    captcha.value = null; // server unreachable: the login will fail with a clear message
  }
}

defineExpose({ reload, captchaId: () => captcha.value?.id ?? '' });
onMounted(reload);
</script>

<template>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label class="form-label" for="captcha">{{ t('CAPTCHA.LABEL') }}</label>
    <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 mb-2">
      <div class="captcha-image" role="img" :aria-label="t('CAPTCHA.IMAGE_ALT')" v-html="captcha?.svg ?? ''"></div>
      <a href="#" class="small" @click.prevent="reload">{{ t('CAPTCHA.NEW_IMAGE') }}</a>
    </div>
    <input id="captcha" v-model="input" type="text" maxlength="10" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false"
           class="form-control" :class="{ 'is-invalid': error }">
    <div v-if="error" class="invalid-feedback">{{ t(error) }}</div>
    <div v-else class="form-text">{{ t('CAPTCHA.HELP') }}</div>
  </div>
</template>
  • lines 30–37: a new CAPTCHA; the previous input is cleared;
  • line 39: what the PARENT can call on this component, via a template reference (see [LoginView.vue]). Without [defineExpose], a [<script setup>] component exposes nothing;
  • Line 47: The SVG image, inserted as-is: it comes from our server (see Example 17).

docs.title: 10.12.7. src/components/BookingDialog.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  components/BookingDialog.vue - the dialog to book a slot
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Same dialog as views/partials/booking.hbs of the HTML application
  (and as the booking-dialog component of the Angular client): the
  Bootstrap classes of a modal dialog, displayed "hard-coded" (show d-block).

  The component does not talk to the server: it emits
    - 'confirm' with the chosen patient (null for a patient who books
      for themselves);
    - 'close'.
  It is the schedule page that decides what to do with it (ScheduleView.vue).
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import type { Person } from '../api/types';
import { label } from '../composables/useFormatting';

const props = defineProps<{
  time: string; // "8:00 - 8:20"
  clients: Person[]; // ADMIN / DOCTOR: the patients to choose from
  patient: string | null; // USER: the patient is themselves
  submitting: boolean;
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{ confirm: [clientId: number | null]; close: [] }>();

const { t } = useI18n();
const clientId = ref<number | null>(null);
const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLSelectElement>('list');
const confirmButton = useTemplateRef<HTMLButtonElement>('confirmButton');

function onEscape(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    emit('close');
  }
}

onMounted(() => {
  // the focus on the first useful element of the dialog
  (props.patient === null ? list.value : confirmButton.value)?.focus();
  document.addEventListener('keydown', onEscape);
});
onUnmounted(() => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onEscape));
</script>

<template>
  <Teleport to="body">
    <div class="modal-backdrop fade show"></div>
    <div class="modal fade show d-block" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="booking-title"
         @click.self="emit('close')">
      <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
        <form class="modal-content" @submit.prevent="emit('confirm', clientId)">
          <div class="modal-header">
            <h5 id="booking-title" class="modal-title">{{ t('BOOKING_DIALOG.TITLE') }}</h5>
            <button type="button" class="btn-close" :aria-label="t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CLOSE_ARIA')" @click="emit('close')"></button>
          </div>

          <div class="modal-body">
            <p>{{ t('BOOKING_DIALOG.SLOT', { time }) }}</p>
            <!-- a patient books for themselves: no list (and the server
                 would ignore a possible clientId anyway) -->
            <p v-if="patient !== null" class="mb-0">{{ t('BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL') }}: <strong>{{ patient }}</strong></p>
            <template v-else>
              <label class="form-label" for="clientId">{{ t('BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL') }}</label>
              <select id="clientId" ref="list" v-model="clientId" class="form-select">
                <option :value="null">{{ t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CHOOSE_PATIENT') }}</option>
                <option v-for="c in clients" :key="c.id" :value="c.id">{{ label(c) }}</option>
              </select>
            </template>
          </div>

          <div class="modal-footer">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" @click="emit('close')">{{ t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CANCEL') }}</button>
            <button ref="confirmButton" type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" :disabled="submitting">{{ t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CONFIRM') }}</button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </Teleport>
</template>

The appointment booking window. It does not communicate with the server: it sends either [confirm] with the selected patient, or [close]. The calendar page decides what to do with it.

  • lines 22–27: the appointment time, and either the list of patients (ADMIN, DOCTOR) or the name of the logged-in patient (USER);
  • Lines 42–46: Upon opening, the focus goes to the first applicable element (the list of patients or the “Confirm” button); the Esc key closes the window;
  • line 56: a real form: the Enter key confirms;
  • line 66: a patient makes a reservation for themselves: no list.

docs.title: 10.13.1. src/views/LoginView.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  views/LoginView.vue - the login page (/login)
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Same page as views/login.hbs of the HTML application: login,
  password, captcha, and a second button "Create a patient account" that checks
  the SAME captcha before opening the account creation.

  /login?login=jbernard: the login field is pre-filled (right after the
  creation of an account).
  /login?redirect=/doctors: after login, this page is opened
  (set by the router guard) rather than the home page of the role.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, reactive, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { ApiError } from '../api/http-client';
import { rdvApi } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { useSessionStore } from '../stores/session';
import { useMessagesStore } from '../stores/messages';
import CaptchaField from '../components/CaptchaField.vue';

const { t } = useI18n();
const route = useRoute();
const router = useRouter();
const session = useSessionStore();
const messages = useMessagesStore();

const form = reactive({
  login: typeof route.query.login === 'string' ? route.query.login.slice(0, 30) : '',
  password: '',
  captcha: '',
});
const captchaError = ref<string | undefined>(undefined);
const submitting = ref(false);
const captchaField = useTemplateRef<InstanceType<typeof CaptchaField>>('captchaField');
const loginField = useTemplateRef<HTMLInputElement>('loginField');
const passwordField = useTemplateRef<HTMLInputElement>('passwordField');

// the focus: on the password if the login is already filled in
onMounted(() => (form.login ? passwordField.value : loginField.value)?.focus());

// both buttons share this sequence: submission, then, on failure,
// error message and a NEW image (each one is used only once)
async function attempt(action: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  messages.clear();
  captchaError.value = undefined;
  submitting.value = true;
  try {
    await action();
  } catch (e) {
    messages.showApiError(e);
    if (e instanceof ApiError) {
      captchaError.value = e.fields.captcha;
    }
    await captchaField.value?.reload();
  } finally {
    submitting.value = false;
  }
}

function logIn(): Promise<void> {
  return attempt(async () => {
    await session.logIn(form.login.trim(), form.password, captchaField.value?.captchaId() ?? '', form.captcha);
    const redirect = route.query.redirect;
    // only an INTERNAL path: never a redirect to another site
    router.push(typeof redirect === 'string' && redirect.startsWith('/') && !redirect.startsWith('//') ? redirect : session.homePage);
  });
}

function createAccount(): Promise<void> {
  return attempt(async () => {
    await rdvApi.registrationAccess(captchaField.value?.captchaId() ?? '', form.captcha);
    router.push({ name: 'register' });
  });
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="row justify-content-center">
    <div class="col-sm-8 col-md-6 col-lg-5">
      <div class="card p-4">
        <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ t('LOGIN.TITLE') }}</h5>

        <form @submit.prevent="logIn">
          <div class="mb-3">
            <label class="form-label" for="login">{{ t('LOGIN.LOGIN_LABEL') }}</label>
            <input id="login" ref="loginField" v-model="form.login" type="text" class="form-control" autocomplete="username" required>
          </div>
          <div class="mb-3">
            <label class="form-label" for="password">{{ t('LOGIN.PASSWORD_LABEL') }}</label>
            <input id="password" ref="passwordField" v-model="form.password" type="password" class="form-control"
                   autocomplete="current-password" required>
          </div>

          <CaptchaField ref="captchaField" v-model="form.captcha" :error="captchaError" />

          <!-- type="submit": Enter in a field triggers "Log in" -->
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100" :disabled="submitting">{{ t('LOGIN.SUBMIT') }}</button>

          <!-- type="button": this button does not submit the form (no
               required check on login and password, useless here) -->
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary w-100 mt-3" :disabled="submitting" @click="createAccount">
            {{ t('LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT') }}
          </button>
          <div class="form-text text-center">{{ t('LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT_HELP') }}</div>
        </form>

        <div class="text-muted small mt-3">
          {{ t('LOGIN.DEMO_ACCOUNTS') }}
          <ul class="mb-0 mt-1">
            <li><code>admin</code> - {{ t('LOGIN.DEMO_ADMIN') }}</li>
            <li><code>pelissier</code>, <code>tatou</code>, <code>dupont</code> - {{ t('LOGIN.DEMO_DOCTOR') }}</li>
            <li><code>martin</code>, <code>durand</code>, <code>bistrou</code>, <code>german</code> - {{ t('LOGIN.DEMO_USER') }}</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
  • line 32: [/login?login=jbernard] pre-fills the login field (immediately after creating an account);
  • line 38: a reference to the [CaptchaField] COMPONENT: we can call what it exposes ([reload()], [captchaId()]). [InstanceType<typeof CaptchaField>] is its type;
  • line 43: the focus is on the password field if the username is already filled in;
  • lines 47–62: both buttons follow the same sequence: submission; if unsuccessful, an error message appears, along with an error below the CAPTCHA field if applicable, and a NEW image;
  • lines 64–71: the login, followed by the page requested before the login (parameter [redirect], set by the router), or the role’s home page. Only an internal path is accepted: it must begin with [/], but not with [//] ([//site.com/...] refers to ANOTHER site);
  • lines 73–78: “Create a patient account”: the server verifies the CAPTCHA and issues a token; the account creation page then opens;
  • line 105: [type="button"]: this button does not submit the form. In the HTML application, this was a second button for submitting the same form to a different address ([formaction]).

docs.title: 10.13.2. src/views/ScheduleView.vue
docs.text:
The main page. As in the HTML application, ALL its state is in the URL:

/schedule                                           choice of the doctor and the day
/schedule?doctorId=1&day=2026-10-05                 the schedule
/schedule?doctorId=1&day=2026-10-05&book=7          + the booking dialog for slot 7

<!--
  =========================================================================
  views/ScheduleView.vue - the schedule page (/schedule)
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Three blocks, like views/schedule.hbs of the HTML application:
    1. the choice of the doctor and of the day;
    2. the schedule of that doctor on that day;
    3. the dialog to book a slot.

  As in the HTML application, ALL the state of the page is in its URL:
      /schedule?doctorId=1&day=2026-10-05             the schedule
      /schedule?doctorId=1&day=2026-10-05&book=7      + the booking dialog
  The page can therefore be reloaded, bookmarked, and the browser's Back /
  Forward buttons can be used. The page FOLLOWS its URL: a watch on the
  query reloads the schedule; the user's actions, on the other hand, change
  the URL (router.push).

  What each user sees and can do is decided by the SERVER (fields
  patient, mine, bookable, appointmentId of each slot): the page merely
  displays it. A patient does not even receive the name of the other patients.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onMounted, reactive, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { RouterLink, useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { ApiError } from '../api/http-client';
import { rdvApi } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { Schedule, ScheduleSlot, Person } from '../api/types';
import { today, isValidDate, label, useFormatting } from '../composables/useFormatting';
import { useConfirmation } from '../composables/useConfirmation';
import { useSessionStore } from '../stores/session';
import { useMessagesStore } from '../stores/messages';
import BookingDialog from '../components/BookingDialog.vue';

const { t } = useI18n();
const route = useRoute();
const router = useRouter();
const session = useSessionStore();
const messages = useMessagesStore();
const { timeRange, longDate } = useFormatting();
const { confirm } = useConfirmation();

const doctors = ref<Person[]>([]);
const clients = ref<Person[]>([]); // ADMIN / DOCTOR: for the booking dialog
const schedule = ref<Schedule | null>(null);
const loading = ref(false);
const submitting = ref(false);

// the values of the "doctor + day" form, copied from the URL
const choice = reactive<{ doctorId: number | null; day: string }>({ doctorId: null, day: today() });

// "3" -> 3 ; "", "abc", "-2", absent -> null
function positiveInteger(value: unknown): number | null {
  const n = Number(value);
  return typeof value === 'string' && value !== '' && Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0 ? n : null;
}

// the displayed schedule, without booking dialog: the "back" query
const scheduleQuery = computed(() => ({ doctorId: String(choice.doctorId ?? ''), day: choice.day }));

// the slot whose booking dialog is open (?book=7),
// only if it is bookable by this user
const slotToBook = computed<ScheduleSlot | null>(() => {
  const id = positiveInteger(route.query.book);
  return schedule.value?.slots.find((s) => s.id === id && s.bookable) ?? null;
});

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// loading
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
onMounted(async () => {
  try {
    doctors.value = await rdvApi.list('doctors');
    // the list of patients: only for those allowed to read it
    if (session.isManager) {
      clients.value = await rdvApi.list('clients');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    messages.showApiError(e);
  }
});

// the schedule follows the URL (doctor and day)
watch(() => [route.query.doctorId, route.query.day], loadSchedule, { immediate: true });

async function loadSchedule(): Promise<void> {
  // the day: the one in the URL if it is valid, otherwise today
  const rawDay = route.query.day;
  choice.day = today();
  if (rawDay !== undefined) {
    if (!isValidDate(rawDay)) {
      schedule.value = null;
      messages.showError('ERRORS.INVALID_DATE');
      return;
    }
    choice.day = rawDay;
  }
  // the doctor: the one in the URL; without a doctor, a DOCTOR sees THEIR schedule
  // (the server finds it from the token)
  choice.doctorId = positiveInteger(route.query.doctorId);
  if (choice.doctorId === null && session.role !== 'DOCTOR') {
    schedule.value = null;
    return;
  }
  loading.value = true;
  try {
    schedule.value = await rdvApi.schedule(choice.doctorId, choice.day);
    choice.doctorId = schedule.value.doctor.id;
  } catch (e) {
    schedule.value = null;
    messages.showApiError(e);
  } finally {
    loading.value = false;
  }
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// actions
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------

// "View schedule": the URL is changed, the schedule follows (watch above)
function viewSchedule(): void {
  router.push({ query: scheduleQuery.value });
}

function closeBooking(): void {
  router.push({ query: scheduleQuery.value });
}

async function book(clientId: number | null): Promise<void> {
  const slot = slotToBook.value;
  if (slot === null) {
    return;
  }
  submitting.value = true;
  try {
    await rdvApi.book(choice.day, slot.id, session.isManager ? clientId : null);
    messages.flash('success', 'SCHEDULE.BOOKED');
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof ApiError && e.key === 'ERRORS.CHOOSE_PATIENT') {
      // no patient chosen: the dialog stays open
      messages.showError(e.key);
      return; // (finally runs all the same)
    }
    if (!(e instanceof ApiError)) {
      throw e;
    }
    // slot taken in the meantime, patient who already has an appointment...:
    // the message will be displayed on the schedule, dialog closed
    messages.flash('error', e.key, e.params);
  } finally {
    submitting.value = false;
  }
  await router.push({ query: scheduleQuery.value });
  await loadSchedule(); // the server is the reference: the schedule is read again
}

async function cancel(s: ScheduleSlot): Promise<void> {
  if (s.appointmentId === null || !(await confirm('SCHEDULE.CANCEL_CONFIRM'))) {
    return;
  }
  try {
    await rdvApi.cancelAppointment(s.appointmentId);
    messages.showSuccess('SCHEDULE.CANCELLED');
  } catch (e) {
    messages.showApiError(e);
  }
  await loadSchedule();
}
</script>

<template>
  <!-- 1. the choice of the doctor and of the day -->
  <form class="card p-3 mb-3" @submit.prevent="viewSchedule">
    <div class="row g-2 align-items-end">
      <div class="col-sm-5">
        <label class="form-label" for="doctorId">{{ t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DOCTOR_LABEL') }}</label>
        <select id="doctorId" v-model="choice.doctorId" class="form-select" required>
          <option :value="null">{{ t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.CHOOSE_DOCTOR') }}</option>
          <option v-for="d in doctors" :key="d.id" :value="d.id">{{ label(d) }}</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="col-sm-4">
        <label class="form-label" for="day">{{ t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DAY_LABEL') }}</label>
        <input id="day" v-model="choice.day" type="date" class="form-control" required>
      </div>
      <div class="col-sm-3">
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100">{{ t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.VIEW_SCHEDULE') }}</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </form>

  <!-- patient who already has an upcoming appointment: why there is no "Book" button -->
  <div v-if="schedule?.info" class="alert alert-info">
    {{ t(schedule.info) }} <RouterLink to="/my-area" class="alert-link">{{ t('APP.MENU_MY_AREA') }}</RouterLink>
  </div>

  <!-- 2. the schedule -->
  <p v-if="loading && !schedule" class="text-muted">{{ t('APP.LOADING') }}</p>
  <div v-else-if="schedule" class="card p-3">
    <h5>{{ t('SCHEDULE.TITLE_PREFIX') }} {{ longDate(schedule.day) }} - {{ label(schedule.doctor) }}</h5>
    <table v-if="schedule.slots.length > 0" class="table table-hover align-middle">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>{{ t('SCHEDULE.COLUMN_SLOT') }}</th>
          <th>{{ t('SCHEDULE.COLUMN_STATUS') }}</th>
          <th></th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr v-for="s in schedule.slots" :key="s.id" :class="{ 'free-slot': s.bookable }">
          <td>{{ timeRange(s) }}</td>
          <td>
            <span v-if="s.free" class="badge text-bg-success">{{ t('SCHEDULE.FREE') }}</span>
            <span v-else-if="s.patient" class="badge" :class="s.mine ? 'text-bg-primary' : 'text-bg-secondary'">{{ label(s.patient) }}</span>
            <span v-else class="badge text-bg-secondary">{{ t('SCHEDULE.BOOKED_BY_OTHER') }}</span>
          </td>
          <td class="text-end">
            <!-- "Book" is a LINK: it adds ?book=... to the URL, which
                 opens the booking dialog -->
            <RouterLink v-if="s.bookable" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-success" :to="{ query: { ...scheduleQuery, book: s.id } }">
              {{ t('SCHEDULE.BOOK') }}
            </RouterLink>
            <button v-if="s.appointmentId !== null" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" @click="cancel(s)">
              {{ t('SCHEDULE.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT') }}
            </button>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <p v-else class="text-muted mb-0">{{ t('SCHEDULE.NO_SLOTS') }}</p>
  </div>
  <p v-else class="text-muted">{{ t('SCHEDULE.EMPTY_STATE') }}</p>

  <!-- 3. the booking dialog, only if the URL contains &book=... -->
  <BookingDialog
    v-if="slotToBook"
    :time="timeRange(slotToBook)"
    :clients="clients"
    :patient="session.isPatient ? (session.user?.name ?? '') : null"
    :submitting="submitting"
    @confirm="book"
    @close="closeBooking"
  />
</template>

Page data:

  • lines 44–48: the lists, the displayed calendar, and the loading and sending indicators;
  • line 51: the values from the “doctor + day” form. They are copied FROM the URL; the user can modify them without any effect until they click “View schedule”;
  • line 60: the [query] for the displayed calendar, without a booking window;
  • Lines 64–67: the time slot for which the window is open: [?book=...], if it exists AND if it is bookable by this user. A manually created URL ([book=] on a booked time slot) therefore does not open any booking window.

Loading:

  • Lines 72–82: the list of doctors is visible to everyone, while the list of patients is visible only to those authorized to view it;
  • line 85: the page FOLLOWS the URL. [immediate]: The calendar loads as soon as the page is displayed (a bookmarked URL, a F5); then every time the doctor or the date in the URL changes (by clicking “View schedule” or the Previous/Next buttons). A change to [book] alone does not reload the calendar: it merely opens or closes the window (see [slotToBook]);
  • lines 87–116: the day from the URL (today by default; an error occurs if it does not exist); the doctor from the URL; if no doctor is specified, a logged-in doctor sees THEIR calendar (the server retrieves it using the token), and the doctor returned by the server is then copied into the form.

Actions:

  • lines 123–125: “View schedule” does not load anything itself: it changes the URL, and the calendar updates accordingly;
  • lines 131–157: the appointment:
    • if no patient is selected: the server uses the one from the token;
    • no patient selected (ADMIN, DOCTOR): the window remains open, displaying the message;
    • success or other rejection (slot taken in the meantime, patient already has an appointment): a pop-up message, then the URL without [book] (the window closes), followed by a reload of the calendar: the server’s version is final;
  • lines 159–170: cancellation, after confirmation. The server returns [appointmentId] for the time slots the user can cancel: for a ADMIN or a DOCTOR, all of them; for a patient, their own (the HTML application only allowed them to cancel from “My area”; the API also allows it from the calendar).

The template:

  • line 175: selection of the doctor and the day;
  • line 195: a patient who already has an upcoming appointment: why there is no “Book” button;
  • line 202: the day, formatted in the current language;
  • lines 216 and 217: the patient’s name, if it was submitted; otherwise, “Booked”;
  • line 222: “Book” is a LINK: it adds [book=...] to the URL. The browser’s Back button therefore closes the window;
  • lines 237–244: the window, when requested by the URL.

docs.title: 10.13.3. src/views/persons.config.ts
docs.text:
The pages for managing doctors and clients are shared. What distinguishes them:

// =========================================================================
// views/persons.config.ts - doctors or clients?
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The pages to manage doctors and clients are IDENTICAL: same
// list, same form. As in the HTML application (abstract class
// PersonsController), they are written ONCE (PersonsView.vue,
// PersonFormView.vue); only the address of the API and the
// keys of the labels change, described here. The router gives the type in the
// meta property of each route (see router.ts).
// =========================================================================

import type { PersonType } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';

export interface PersonKeys {
  title: string; // "Doctors"
  add: string; // "Add a doctor"
  edit: string; // "Edit a doctor"
  empty: string; // "No doctors."
  confirmDelete: string;
  added: string; // "Doctor {name} has been added (login: {login})."
  edited: string;
  deleted: string;
}

export const PERSON_KEYS: Record<PersonType, PersonKeys> = {
  doctors: {
    title: 'DOCTORS.TITLE',
    add: 'DOCTORS.ADD',
    edit: 'DOCTORS.EDIT',
    empty: 'DOCTORS.EMPTY',
    confirmDelete: 'DOCTORS.DELETE_CONFIRM',
    added: 'DOCTORS.ADDED',
    edited: 'DOCTORS.UPDATED',
    deleted: 'DOCTORS.DELETED',
  },
  clients: {
    title: 'CLIENTS.TITLE',
    add: 'CLIENTS.ADD',
    edit: 'CLIENTS.EDIT',
    empty: 'CLIENTS.EMPTY',
    confirmDelete: 'CLIENTS.DELETE_CONFIRM',
    added: 'CLIENTS.ADDED',
    edited: 'CLIENTS.UPDATED',
    deleted: 'CLIENTS.DELETED',
  },
};

// {name} and {login} of the "added / updated / deleted" messages
export function messageParams(p: { firstName: string; lastName: string; login?: string }): Record<string, string> {
  return { name: `${p.firstName} ${p.lastName}`, login: p.login ?? '' };
}
  • line 25: the keys for the labels specific to each type, as in the [DoctorsController] and [ClientsController] controllers of the HTML application;
  • lines 49–51: the parameters [{name}] and [{login}] for the “added/modified/deleted” messages.

docs.title: 10.13.4. src/views/PersonsView.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  views/PersonsView.vue - the list of doctors OR of clients (ADMIN)
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  A single page for both: the type ('doctors' or 'clients') is in
  the metadata of the route (route.meta.type, see router.ts), the labels
  specific to each in persons.config.ts. Equivalent of
  views/persons/list.hbs of the HTML application.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { RouterLink, useRoute } from 'vue-router';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { rdvApi, type PersonType } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { Person } from '../api/types';
import { useConfirmation } from '../composables/useConfirmation';
import { useMessagesStore } from '../stores/messages';
import { PERSON_KEYS, messageParams } from './persons.config';

const { t } = useI18n();
const route = useRoute();
const messages = useMessagesStore();
const { confirm } = useConfirmation();

const type = route.meta.type as PersonType;
const keys = PERSON_KEYS[type];
const persons = ref<Person[] | null>(null); // null: not loaded yet
const empty = computed(() => persons.value !== null && persons.value.length === 0);

async function load(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    persons.value = await rdvApi.list(type);
  } catch (e) {
    messages.showApiError(e);
  }
}

async function remove(p: Person): Promise<void> {
  if (!(await confirm(keys.confirmDelete))) {
    return;
  }
  try {
    await rdvApi.remove(type, p.id);
    messages.showSuccess(keys.deleted, messageParams(p));
  } catch (e) {
    // a doctor who still has appointments: 409 ERRORS.DOCTOR_HAS_APPOINTMENTS
    messages.showApiError(e);
  }
  await load();
}

onMounted(load);
</script>

<template>
  <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3">
    <h4 class="mb-0">{{ t(keys.title) }}</h4>
    <RouterLink class="btn btn-primary" :to="`/${type}/add`">{{ t(keys.add) }}</RouterLink>
  </div>

  <div class="card p-3">
    <p v-if="persons === null" class="text-muted mb-0">{{ t('APP.LOADING') }}</p>
    <p v-else-if="empty" class="text-muted mb-0">{{ t(keys.empty) }}</p>
    <table v-else class="table table-hover align-middle mb-0">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>{{ t('PERSONS.COLUMN_TITLE') }}</th>
          <th>{{ t('PERSONS.COLUMN_FIRSTNAME') }}</th>
          <th>{{ t('PERSONS.COLUMN_LASTNAME') }}</th>
          <th>{{ t('PERSONS.COLUMN_LOGIN') }}</th>
          <th></th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr v-for="p in persons" :key="p.id">
          <td>{{ p.title }}</td>
          <td>{{ p.firstName }}</td>
          <td>{{ p.lastName }}</td>
          <td><code>{{ p.login }}</code></td>
          <td class="text-end">
            <div class="d-inline-flex gap-2">
              <RouterLink class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" :to="`/${type}/${p.id}/edit`">{{ t('PERSONS.EDIT') }}</RouterLink>
              <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" @click="remove(p)">{{ t('PERSONS.DELETE') }}</button>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</template>
  • line 26: the type of people, read from the route’s metadata. It will not change during the component’s lifetime: when switching from [/doctors] to [/clients], the key [:key] from [<RouterView>] recreates the page;
  • line 28: [null] as long as the list has not been loaded: this distinguishes between “loading” and “empty list”;
  • lines 39–51: confirmation, deletion, message, and reloading of the list. If a doctor still has appointments: the server returns a 409 response, and the message is displayed at the bottom of the page.

docs.title: 10.13.5. src/views/PersonFormView.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  views/PersonFormView.vue - creation OR update of a doctor
  or of a client (ADMIN)
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    /doctors/add               -> creation (no id prop)
    /doctors/3/edit            -> update (prop id = 3, see router.ts)
  (and the same addresses under /clients). Equivalent of
  views/persons/form.hbs of the HTML application.

  No rule is checked here: the server validates everything, and its errors
  are displayed under the fields (see composables/useForm.ts).
  The VERSION read with the record goes back with the update: if another
  ADMIN has changed it in the meantime, the server answers 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onMounted, reactive } from 'vue';
import { RouterLink, useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { ApiError } from '../api/http-client';
import { rdvApi, type PersonType } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { PersonData } from '../api/types';
import { useForm } from '../composables/useForm';
import { useMessagesStore } from '../stores/messages';
import PersonFields from '../components/PersonFields.vue';
import InputField from '../components/InputField.vue';
import { PERSON_KEYS, messageParams } from './persons.config';

const props = defineProps<{ id?: number }>();

const { t } = useI18n();
const route = useRoute();
const router = useRouter();
const messages = useMessagesStore();
const { errors, params, submitting, submit } = useForm();

const type = route.meta.type as PersonType;
const keys = PERSON_KEYS[type];
const creating = computed(() => props.id === undefined);

const form = reactive<PersonData>({ title: 'Mr', firstName: '', lastName: '', login: '', password: '', version: undefined });

// update: the record is read (including its version)
onMounted(async () => {
  if (props.id === undefined) {
    return;
  }
  try {
    const p = await rdvApi.read(type, props.id);
    Object.assign(form, { title: p.title, firstName: p.firstName, lastName: p.lastName, login: p.login ?? '', version: p.version });
  } catch (e) {
    // record that does not exist (deleted in the meantime...): back to the list
    if (e instanceof ApiError) {
      messages.flash('error', e.key, e.params);
      router.push(`/${type}`);
      return;
    }
    throw e;
  }
});

async function save(): Promise<void> {
  const succeeded = await submit(async () => {
    const p = props.id === undefined ? await rdvApi.add(type, form) : await rdvApi.edit(type, props.id, form);
    messages.flash('success', creating.value ? keys.added : keys.edited, messageParams(p));
  });
  if (succeeded) {
    router.push(`/${type}`);
  } else if (messages.error?.key === 'ERRORS.DOCTOR_NOT_FOUND' || messages.error?.key === 'ERRORS.PATIENT_NOT_FOUND') {
    // deleted in the meantime by another ADMIN: back to the list
    messages.flash('error', messages.error.key);
    router.push(`/${type}`);
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="row justify-content-center">
    <div class="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
      <div class="card p-4">
        <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ t(creating ? keys.add : keys.edit) }}</h5>
        <!-- novalidate: it is the SERVER that validates (it is the reference) -->
        <form novalidate @submit.prevent="save">
          <PersonFields v-model:title="form.title" v-model:firstName="form.firstName" v-model:lastName="form.lastName" :errors="errors" />

          <h6 class="mt-4 text-muted">{{ t('PERSONS.ACCOUNT_SECTION') }}</h6>
          <InputField v-model="form.login" class="mb-3" id="login" label="PERSONS.LOGIN_LABEL" :maxlength="30"
                      :error="errors.login" :help="creating ? 'PERSONS.LOGIN_HELP_CREATE' : 'PERSONS.LOGIN_HELP_EDIT'" />
          <!-- never pre-filled: the password never comes back from the server -->
          <InputField v-model="form.password" class="mb-4" id="password" type="password" label="PERSONS.PASSWORD_LABEL"
                      :maxlength="72" autocomplete="new-password" :error="errors.password" :params="params"
                      :help="creating ? 'PERSONS.PASSWORD_HELP_CREATE' : 'PERSONS.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT'" />

          <div class="d-flex gap-2">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" :disabled="submitting">{{ t('PERSONS.SAVE') }}</button>
            <RouterLink class="btn btn-secondary" :to="`/${type}`">{{ t('PERSONS.BACK') }}</RouterLink>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
  • line 30: creation without [id], modification with it (the property comes from the route; see [router.ts]);
  • line 36: form errors (see [useForm.ts]);
  • lines 45–61: during modification, read the record, including the version. If it does not exist (deleted in the meantime), return to the list with a message;
  • lines 63–75: POST or PUT; if successful, display a message and return to the list. If the operation fails, [useForm] has already displayed the errors; if a record has been deleted in the meantime, the program returns to the list;
  • line 84: [novalidate]: the server validates this;
  • line 85: the three named [v-model] commands;
  • line 91: the password is never pre-filled: it is never returned from the server.

docs.title: 10.13.6. src/views/RegisterView.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  views/RegisterView.vue - "Create a patient account" (/register, public)
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  One only gets here after typing the captcha of the login page
  (button "Create a patient account"): the server has then issued a
  pass, which the route guard has checked (see router.ts).
  Same fields as the ADMIN's form, but the login and the password
  are required, with confirmation. Equivalent of
  views/account/registration.hbs of the HTML application.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive } from 'vue';
import { RouterLink, useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { rdvApi } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { Registration } from '../api/types';
import { useForm } from '../composables/useForm';
import { useMessagesStore } from '../stores/messages';
import PersonFields from '../components/PersonFields.vue';
import InputField from '../components/InputField.vue';

const { t } = useI18n();
const router = useRouter();
const messages = useMessagesStore();
const { errors, params, submitting, submit } = useForm();

// minimum length of a password chosen by a patient: same value
// as the server (which also returns {min} with the PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT error)
const PASSWORD_MIN = '6';

const form = reactive<Registration>({ title: 'Mr', firstName: '', lastName: '', login: '', password: '', confirmation: '' });

async function create(): Promise<void> {
  let login = '';
  const succeeded = await submit(async () => {
    login = (await rdvApi.register(form)).login;
  });
  if (succeeded) {
    // back to the login page, login pre-filled
    messages.flash('success', 'REGISTRATION.DONE', { login });
    router.push({ name: 'login', query: { login } });
  } else if (messages.error?.key === 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT') {
    // pass expired (15 minutes): back to the captcha
    messages.flash('error', 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT');
    router.push({ name: 'login' });
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="row justify-content-center">
    <div class="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
      <div class="card p-4">
        <h5 class="card-title mb-1">{{ t('REGISTRATION.TITLE') }}</h5>
        <p class="text-muted small mb-3">{{ t('REGISTRATION.INTRO') }}</p>
        <form novalidate @submit.prevent="create">
          <PersonFields v-model:title="form.title" v-model:firstName="form.firstName" v-model:lastName="form.lastName" :errors="errors" />

          <h6 class="mt-4 text-muted">{{ t('PERSONS.ACCOUNT_SECTION') }}</h6>
          <InputField v-model="form.login" class="mb-3" id="login" label="PERSONS.LOGIN_LABEL" :maxlength="30"
                      autocomplete="username" required :error="errors.login" help="REGISTRATION.LOGIN_HELP" />
          <div class="row g-3 mb-3">
            <InputField v-model="form.password" class="col-sm-6" id="password" type="password" label="PERSONS.PASSWORD_LABEL"
                        :maxlength="72" autocomplete="new-password" required :error="errors.password"
                        :params="{ min: PASSWORD_MIN, ...params }" help="REGISTRATION.PASSWORD_HELP" />
            <InputField v-model="form.confirmation" class="col-sm-6" id="confirmation" type="password"
                        label="ACCOUNT.CONFIRMATION_LABEL" :maxlength="72" autocomplete="new-password" required
                        :error="errors.confirmation" />
          </div>
          <div class="d-flex gap-2">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" :disabled="submitting">{{ t('REGISTRATION.SUBMIT') }}</button>
            <RouterLink class="btn btn-secondary" to="/login">{{ t('REGISTRATION.BACK_TO_LOGIN') }}</RouterLink>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
  • line 31: the minimum password length, for the help message (the server also returns this in [params], along with the error);
  • lines 35–49: account creation, followed by the login page with the username pre-filled. If the token has expired (15 minutes), the server responds with a 403 error: return to the login page to solve a new CAPTCHA;
  • line 67: the message parameters for the field; [...params] (the spread operator) copies those returned by the server.

Access to this page is controlled by the [beforeEnter] guard on its route (see [router.ts]).

docs.title: 10.13.7. src/views/PatientAreaView.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  views/PatientAreaView.vue - "My area" (/my-area, USER role)
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The home page of the patient, right after login:
    - two options: [Manage my account] and [View a schedule];
    - their upcoming appointment, if they have one, with the means to cancel it.
  Equivalent of views/patient/area.hbs of the HTML application.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { RouterLink } from 'vue-router';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { rdvApi } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { MyArea } from '../api/types';
import { useFormatting } from '../composables/useFormatting';
import { useConfirmation } from '../composables/useConfirmation';
import { useMessagesStore } from '../stores/messages';

const { t } = useI18n();
const messages = useMessagesStore();
const { label, timeRange, longDate } = useFormatting();
const { confirm } = useConfirmation();

const area = ref<MyArea | null>(null);

async function load(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    area.value = await rdvApi.myArea();
  } catch (e) {
    messages.showApiError(e);
  }
}

async function cancel(appointmentId: number): Promise<void> {
  if (!(await confirm('SCHEDULE.CANCEL_CONFIRM'))) {
    return;
  }
  try {
    await rdvApi.cancelAppointment(appointmentId);
    messages.showSuccess('SCHEDULE.CANCELLED');
  } catch (e) {
    messages.showApiError(e);
  }
  await load();
}

onMounted(load);
</script>

<template>
  <template v-if="area">
    <h4 class="mb-3">{{ t('AREA.HELLO', { name: label(area.patient) }) }}</h4>
    <div class="row g-3 mb-4">
      <div class="col-sm-6">
        <RouterLink class="card p-4 h-100 text-decoration-none option-card" to="/my-account">
          <h5 class="mb-1">{{ t('AREA.MANAGE_ACCOUNT') }}</h5>
          <span class="text-muted">{{ t('AREA.MANAGE_ACCOUNT_HELP') }}</span>
        </RouterLink>
      </div>
      <div class="col-sm-6">
        <RouterLink class="card p-4 h-100 text-decoration-none option-card" to="/schedule">
          <h5 class="mb-1">{{ t('AREA.VIEW_SCHEDULE') }}</h5>
          <span class="text-muted">{{ t('AREA.VIEW_SCHEDULE_HELP') }}</span>
        </RouterLink>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card p-3">
      <h5>{{ t('AREA.MY_APPOINTMENT') }}</h5>
      <!-- normally only one (rule "one upcoming appointment at a time"),
           but the page can display several -->
      <div
        v-for="(a, i) in area.appointments"
        :key="a.id"
        class="d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-center gap-2 py-2"
        :class="{ 'border-bottom': i < area.appointments.length - 1 }"
      >
        <div>
          <div class="fw-semibold">{{ longDate(a.day) }}, {{ timeRange(a.slot) }}</div>
          <div class="text-muted">
            {{ label(a.doctor) }} -
            <!-- the doctor's schedule on that day: the patient sees their name in it -->
            <RouterLink :to="{ path: '/schedule', query: { doctorId: a.doctor.id, day: a.day } }">{{ t('AREA.SEE_IN_SCHEDULE') }}</RouterLink>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-danger" @click="cancel(a.id)">{{ t('AREA.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT') }}</button>
      </div>
      <p v-if="area.appointments.length === 0" class="text-muted mb-0">{{ t('AREA.NO_APPOINTMENT') }}</p>
    </div>
  </template>
  <p v-else class="text-muted">{{ t('APP.LOADING') }}</p>
</template>
  • lines 36–47: the patient cancels THEIR appointment (the server would reject one from someone else);
  • line 57: an entire card is a link;
  • line 75: normally only one appointment (the “one upcoming appointment at a time” rule), but the page can display multiple ones;
  • line 85: the doctor’s schedule for that day, where the patient sees their name.

docs.title: 10.13.8. src/views/MyAccountView.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  views/MyAccountView.vue - "Manage my account" (/my-account, USER role)
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Two independent forms, like views/patient/account.hbs:
    1. the update (identity, login, optional new password);
    2. the deletion of the account - which also cancels its appointments.
  Both require the CURRENT password (checked by the server).
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, reactive, ref } from 'vue';
import { RouterLink, useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { rdvApi } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { MyAccountUpdate } from '../api/types';
import { useForm } from '../composables/useForm';
import { useConfirmation } from '../composables/useConfirmation';
import { useSessionStore } from '../stores/session';
import { useMessagesStore } from '../stores/messages';
import PersonFields from '../components/PersonFields.vue';
import InputField from '../components/InputField.vue';

const { t } = useI18n();
const router = useRouter();
const session = useSessionStore();
const messages = useMessagesStore();
const { confirm } = useConfirmation();
// two forms, hence two sets of errors
const update = useForm();
const deletion = useForm();

const form = reactive<MyAccountUpdate>({
  title: 'Mr',
  firstName: '',
  lastName: '',
  login: '',
  password: '',
  confirmation: '',
  currentPassword: '',
  version: 0,
});
const deletePassword = ref('');

onMounted(async () => {
  try {
    Object.assign(form, await rdvApi.myAccount());
  } catch (e) {
    messages.showApiError(e);
  }
});

async function save(): Promise<void> {
  const succeeded = await update.submit(async () => {
    // the server has issued a NEW token (name, login): the navigation
    // bar must follow
    session.update(await rdvApi.editMyAccount(form));
    messages.flash('success', 'MY_ACCOUNT.UPDATED');
  });
  // never a password left in the fields after a submission
  form.currentPassword = '';
  if (succeeded) {
    router.push('/my-area');
  }
}

async function remove(): Promise<void> {
  if (!(await confirm('MY_ACCOUNT.DELETE_CONFIRM'))) {
    return;
  }
  const succeeded = await deletion.submit(async () => {
    await rdvApi.deleteMyAccount(deletePassword.value);
  });
  deletePassword.value = '';
  if (succeeded) {
    session.forget(); // the server has cleared the token cookie
    messages.flash('success', 'MY_ACCOUNT.DELETED');
    router.push({ name: 'login' });
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="row justify-content-center">
    <div class="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
      <!-- 1. update -->
      <div class="card p-4 mb-4">
        <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ t('MY_ACCOUNT.TITLE') }}</h5>
        <form novalidate @submit.prevent="save">
          <PersonFields v-model:title="form.title" v-model:firstName="form.firstName" v-model:lastName="form.lastName" :errors="update.errors.value" />

          <h6 class="mt-4 text-muted">{{ t('PERSONS.ACCOUNT_SECTION') }}</h6>
          <InputField v-model="form.login" class="mb-3" id="login" label="PERSONS.LOGIN_LABEL" :maxlength="30"
                      autocomplete="username" required :error="update.errors.value.login" />
          <div class="row g-3 mb-3">
            <InputField v-model="form.password" class="col-sm-6" id="password" type="password" label="MY_ACCOUNT.NEW_PASSWORD_LABEL"
                        :maxlength="72" autocomplete="new-password" :error="update.errors.value.password"
                        :params="update.params.value" help="PERSONS.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT" />
            <InputField v-model="form.confirmation" class="col-sm-6" id="confirmation" type="password"
                        label="ACCOUNT.CONFIRMATION_LABEL" :maxlength="72" autocomplete="new-password"
                        :error="update.errors.value.confirmation" />
          </div>
          <InputField v-model="form.currentPassword" class="mb-4" id="currentPassword" type="password"
                      label="MY_ACCOUNT.CURRENT_PASSWORD_LABEL" :maxlength="72" autocomplete="current-password" required
                      :error="update.errors.value.currentPassword" help="MY_ACCOUNT.CURRENT_PASSWORD_HELP" />
          <div class="d-flex gap-2">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" :disabled="update.submitting.value">{{ t('PERSONS.SAVE') }}</button>
            <RouterLink class="btn btn-secondary" to="/my-area">{{ t('MY_ACCOUNT.BACK') }}</RouterLink>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>

      <!-- 2. deletion -->
      <div class="card p-4 border-danger">
        <h5 class="card-title text-danger mb-1">{{ t('MY_ACCOUNT.DELETE_TITLE') }}</h5>
        <p class="text-muted small">{{ t('MY_ACCOUNT.DELETE_HELP') }}</p>
        <form class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 align-items-end" novalidate @submit.prevent="remove">
          <InputField v-model="deletePassword" class="flex-grow-1" id="deletePassword" type="password"
                      label="MY_ACCOUNT.CURRENT_PASSWORD_LABEL" :maxlength="72" autocomplete="current-password" required
                      :error="deletion.errors.value.currentPassword" />
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-danger" :disabled="deletion.submitting.value">{{ t('MY_ACCOUNT.DELETE_SUBMIT') }}</button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
  • lines 30–31: two forms, so two sets of errors: a composable can be called as many times as desired, and each call has its own state;
  • line 47: the values read are copied into the form, including the version;
  • lines 53–65: the server has issued a new token (the name and login may have changed); it returns the user as described by this token, and the session is updated: the navigation bar follows suit. The current password is cleared after each submission;
  • lines 67–80: confirmation, deletion; the server has deleted the token cookie: the user is forgotten, and the user is redirected back to the login page;
  • line 90: [update] is a regular object that CONTAINS [ref]s: in the template, you must write [.value] (see Example 11).

docs.title: 8. Communicating with the server
docs.text: The examples in this chapter query the server JSON [RdvMedecins]: It must be running ([npm run start:dev] in the [rdvmedecins-nestjs-json] folder) on port 8080, at the same time as the [Vite] server used in the examples, on port 5173.

docs.title: 8.1.1. The Vite proxy
docs.text:
The example page comes from http://localhost:5173 (the [Vite] server); API is located at http://localhost:8080. To a browser, these are two different origins (the port is part of the origin). However, for security reasons, a browser does not allow a page to read responses from another origin unless the server explicitly permits it (the mechanism known as CORS). And [fetch] does not send cookies (and therefore not the token) to another origin unless asked to do so ([credentials: 'include']) AND the server accepts it, again via CORS.

Rather than opening the server to other origins, we route requests from API through the Vite server. This is the proxy declared in [vite.config.ts]:

  server: {
    port: 5173,
    proxy: {
      '/api': 'http://localhost:8080',
    },
  },

The browser sends [GET http://localhost:5173/api/captcha]; [Vite] forwards the request to [http://localhost:8080/api/captcha], then sends the response back to the browser. From the browser’s perspective, the page and API have the same origin:

In production, there will no longer be a [Vite]: the JSON server itself will serve the compiled client files (see the “Deployment” chapter). The page and API will still share the same origin.

docs.title: 8.1.2. The request
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  17-fetch/src/App.vue - a first HTTP request to the server
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The RdvMedecins JSON server must be running (port 8080). We ask it for
  a captcha: GET /api/captcha -> { "id": "...", "svg": "<svg ...>" }.

    - fetch(url): the browser function that sends an HTTP request.
      It returns a PROMISE: we wait for the response with await;
    - response.ok: true for a 2xx code; response.json() reads the JSON
      body (another promise);
    - the address is RELATIVE (/api/captcha): the request goes to the
      server of the page, Vite (port 5173), which forwards it to the JSON server
      (port 8080) thanks to its proxy (see vite.config.ts);
    - three states to display: in progress, succeeded, failed.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue';

// what GET /api/captcha returns
interface Captcha {
  id: string;
  svg: string;
}

const captcha = ref<Captcha | null>(null);
const loading = ref(false);
const error = ref<string | null>(null);
const requestCount = ref(0);

async function load(): Promise<void> {
  loading.value = true;
  error.value = null;
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/captcha');
    requestCount.value++;
    if (!response.ok) {
      // the server responded, but with an error (4xx, 5xx) - or it is
      // Vite that answers 502/504 because the JSON server is stopped
      throw new Error(`the server responded ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
    }
    captcha.value = (await response.json()) as Captcha;
  } catch (e) {
    // fetch itself fails when no response arrives (network down...)
    error.value = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    captcha.value = null;
  } finally {
    loading.value = false;
  }
}

// on the first display, a captcha is loaded
onMounted(load);
</script>

<template>
  <div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 640px">
    <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Example 17 - a first HTTP request</h1>
    <div class="card p-3">
      <p v-if="loading" class="text-muted">Loading...</p>
      <div v-else-if="error" class="alert alert-danger mb-3">
        Unable to get a captcha: {{ error }}.<br>
        Is the RdvMedecins JSON server running (port 8080)?
      </div>
      <template v-else-if="captcha">
        <!-- v-html: inserts a string as HTML (here, the SVG image).
             To be used ONLY for safe content: this SVG is built by
             OUR server. With user input, v-html would open
             the door to script injection ({{ }}, for its part, escapes everything). -->
        <div class="captcha mb-2" v-html="captcha.svg"></div>
        <p class="small text-muted">id: <code>{{ captcha.id }}</code></p>
      </template>
      <button class="btn btn-primary align-self-start" :disabled="loading" @click="load">Another image</button>
      <p class="small text-muted mt-2 mb-0">{{ requestCount }} successful request(s) - open the Network tab of the developer tools (F12).</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
/* :deep(svg): the rule reaches the <svg> inserted by v-html, which "scoped" would otherwise ignore */
.captcha :deep(svg) {
  border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
}
</style>
  • line 22: the format of the response from [GET /api/captcha];
  • lines 27–29: the three states of a request: in progress, successful (the CAPTCHA), and error;
  • line 36: [fetch(url)], the browser function that sends a request HTTP. It returns a response promise; [await] suspends the function [async] until the promise resolves, without blocking the page. The address is relative: the request is sent to the page’s server, [Vite], which forwards it;
  • Line 38: [fetch] does NOT report an error when the server returns a 404 or 500 response: it did receive a response. It is up to us to test [response.ok] (true for a 2xx code). If the JSON server is down, [Vite] responds with a 5xx error;
  • line 43: [response.json()] reads the body and converts it into an object (yet another promise). [as Captcha] informs [TypeScript] of the object’s format: the compiler cannot verify what the server will send;
  • line 44: [fetch] itself fails when no response is received (network down);
  • line 48: in any case, the request is no longer in progress;
  • line 54: on the first display, a CAPTCHA is loaded;
  • line 71: [v-html] inserts a string like HTML (here, the image SVG). Use ONLY for safe content: this SVG is generated by OUR server. With user-entered data, [v-html] could allow scripts to be injected into the page; the [{{ }}] tokens, on the other hand, escape everything;
  • Line 82: [:deep(...)]: A [scoped] rule normally only affects elements in the template; the [<svg>] inserted by [v-html] is not part of it.

In the browser’s developer tools (F12), the Network tab shows the request [captcha], sent to [localhost:5173], and its response JSON.

docs.title: 8.2. Example 18: Login, Cookie, and Session
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  18-login/src/App.vue - logging in to the RdvMedecins server
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    1. at startup: GET /api/auth/me - are we already logged in?
       (after an F5, the client has forgotten everything; the server reads the cookie);
    2. login: POST /api/auth/login, JSON body { login, password,
       captchaId, captcha }. On success, the server sets the httpOnly
       cookie of the JWT token: our code NEVER sees it (try
       document.cookie in the console: it is not there);
    3. protected request: GET /api/doctors. The browser attaches the cookie
       by itself (same origin);
    4. logout: POST /api/auth/logout - the server deletes the cookie.

  A cookie belongs to a machine (localhost) and to a path (/api): it
  is therefore shared by ALL the examples. Once logged in here, examples 19 and 20
  are logged in too.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, reactive, ref } from 'vue';

interface User {
  login: string;
  name: string;
  role: 'ADMIN' | 'DOCTOR' | 'USER';
}
interface Doctor {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
}
// the shape of ALL the errors of the API
interface ApiError {
  statusCode: number;
  key: string;
  params?: Record<string, string>;
}

// the few messages this example needs (example 20 will use vue-i18n)
const MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  'LOGIN.ERROR': 'Incorrect login or password.',
  'ERRORS.WRONG_CAPTCHA': 'The characters you typed do not match the image.',
  'ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS': 'Too many failed attempts. Try again later.',
};

const user = ref<User | null>(null);
const doctors = ref<Doctor[]>([]);
const captcha = ref<{ id: string; svg: string } | null>(null);
const input = reactive({ login: 'admin', password: '', captcha: '' });
const error = ref<string | null>(null);
const ready = ref(false); // is the initial check finished?

async function loadCaptcha(): Promise<void> {
  captcha.value = await (await fetch('/api/captcha')).json();
  input.captcha = '';
}

// 1. who is logged in? 200 -> the user; 401 -> nobody
async function checkSession(): Promise<void> {
  const response = await fetch('/api/auth/me');
  if (response.ok) {
    user.value = await response.json();
    await loadDoctors();
  } else {
    await loadCaptcha();
  }
  ready.value = true;
}

// 2. logging in
async function logIn(): Promise<void> {
  error.value = null;
  const response = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {
    method: 'POST',
    // the server rejects (415) a POST that is not in JSON
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      login: input.login,
      password: input.password,
      captchaId: captcha.value?.id,
      captcha: input.captcha,
    }),
  });
  if (response.ok) {
    user.value = await response.json();
    input.password = '';
    await loadDoctors();
    return;
  }
  // an error: the JSON body says which one; each image can only be used once
  const e = (await response.json()) as ApiError;
  error.value = `${response.status} - ${MESSAGES[e.key] ?? e.key}`;
  await loadCaptcha();
}

// 3. a protected request
async function loadDoctors(): Promise<void> {
  const response = await fetch('/api/doctors');
  doctors.value = response.ok ? await response.json() : [];
}

// 4. logging out
async function logOut(): Promise<void> {
  await fetch('/api/auth/logout', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' });
  user.value = null;
  doctors.value = [];
  await loadCaptcha();
}

onMounted(() => {
  checkSession().catch(() => {
    error.value = 'Is the RdvMedecins JSON server running (port 8080)?';
    ready.value = true;
  });
});
</script>

<template>
  <div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 640px">
    <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Example 18 - logging in to the server</h1>
    <p v-if="!ready" class="text-muted">Checking the session...</p>

    <!-- logged in -->
    <div v-else-if="user" class="card p-3">
      <p>Logged in: <strong>{{ user.name }}</strong> ({{ user.login }}),
        role <span class="badge text-bg-primary">{{ user.role }}</span></p>
      <h2 class="h6">GET /api/doctors</h2>
      <ul>
        <li v-for="m in doctors" :key="m.id">{{ m.title }} {{ m.firstName }} {{ m.lastName }}</li>
      </ul>
      <p class="small text-muted">Reload the page (F5): you stay logged in.</p>
      <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary align-self-start" @click="logOut">Log out</button>
    </div>

    <!-- not logged in: the form -->
    <form v-else class="card p-3" @submit.prevent="logIn">
      <div class="mb-2">
        <label class="form-label" for="login">Login</label>
        <input id="login" v-model="input.login" class="form-control" autocomplete="username">
      </div>
      <div class="mb-2">
        <label class="form-label" for="password">Password</label>
        <input id="password" v-model="input.password" type="password" class="form-control" autocomplete="current-password">
      </div>
      <div class="mb-3">
        <label class="form-label" for="captcha">Type the characters shown in the image</label>
        <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 mb-2">
          <div v-if="captcha" v-html="captcha.svg"></div>
          <a href="#" class="small" @click.prevent="loadCaptcha">Another image</a>
        </div>
        <input id="captcha" v-model="input.captcha" class="form-control" autocomplete="off">
      </div>

    • line 78: the server rejects a POST that is not in JSON format;
